figurative_meaning_en: To properly execute or manage a responsibility
similar_in_english: Take the bull by the horns
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি কি এই ব্যবসার ঝুঁকি সামলাতে পারবে?
সে সবসময় ঝুঁকি সামলানোর দায়িত্ব নেয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Can you handle the risks of this business?
He always takes on the responsibility of managing risks.
note: This idiom is often used in contexts involving decision-making under uncertainty, reflecting modern Bengali usage in professional settings.
